name: amap-site-selection
description: 面向连锁品牌拓展与个体创业者的门店选址专家能力包。基于高德问店五维选址模型（客群聚集、潜客匹配、同行竞争、交通便利、商业成熟），覆盖商圈推荐、点位评估、多点位对比、立项报告四类完整任务。
descriptionEn: A role-level AI toolkit for store site selection. Built on Amap's five-dimension model (footfall, prospect match, competition, accessibility, commercial maturity), covering trade-area recommendation, single-site evaluation, multi-site comparison and feasibility reporting.
